description: Canonical DAO event catalog — single source of truth for event types, labels, and validation. Served by Edgar at GET /events-catalog. Used by Sophia autopilot and server-side dispatch.

ASSET RECEIPT EVENT.description: Record receipt of a physical DAO asset

CONTRIBUTION EVENT.description: Log time or USD contributions to receive TDG awards

CONTRIBUTION REVIEW EVENT.description: Governor/approver vote on a pending proposal (approve/reject/abstain)

CONTRIBUTOR ADD EVENT.description: Add a new DAO contributor with name and email

CREDENTIALING ATTESTATION EVENT.description: Issue a lineage credential (e.g. program completion)

CREDENTIALING QUALIFICATION EVENT.description: Admission credential for live-cohort students (two-event split: admission → completion)

CURRENCY CONVERSION EVENT.description: Multi-currency conversion between ledgers (e.g. USD→BRL via Wise)

CURRENCY DEFINITION EVENT.description: Define a QR-ready serializable currency row in the Currencies tab (zero -> QR-ready via Edgar only)

DESIGN ORDER EVENT.description: Place an order for white-label chocolate bars with a selected design

DESIGN UPLOAD EVENT.description: Upload white-label chocolate bar artwork (4in x 2in at 300 DPI)

DONATION MINT EVENT.description: Mint a donation pledge QR code

EMAIL REGISTERED EVENT.description: Begin key registration with an email address

EMAIL VERIFICATION EVENT.description: Complete key registration via verification link

FARM BOUNDARY EVIDENCE EVENT.description: Farmer/agent-submitted geotagged boundary evidence (photos/videos of plot boundary markers). GPS embedded in the images is extracted (exiftool); the convex hull forms the approx boundary polygon; the backend creates/updates the farm + plot record (SunMint Farms sheet -> plots/index.geojson -> impact map). CONTRACT: omit Plot ID when unknown - the backend auto-assigns PL-###; NEVER send an empty '- Plot ID:' line (the GAS parser regex swallows the newline and captures the next label - fixed tokenomics #458). Join Media URLs with '; '. Plot Type is REQUIRED (single controlled-vocabulary column: restoration|mature|maturing|enrichment|research|nursery|infrastructure; blank = unclassified and only valid for legacy rows). Include the live UI fields (Is New Farm, Media Count, Captured At, Device GPS) plus Extracted GPS and Area Hectares when available. See agentic_ai_context/SUNMINT_TREE_PHOTO_PROCESSING.md section 6.

FARM REGISTRATION EVENT.description: Register a farm for tree planting and carbon credit programs

MEDIA RETRACTION EVENT.description: Invalidate/retract one or more boundary media submissions (soft-delete: keeps the row, adds invalidated_at/by/reason/source, drops the item out of polygon computation). Triggers a recalculation of the plot polygon (re-run convex hull on remaining GPS points) and regeneration of plots/index.geojson. Three-tier retraction model: submitting farmer/farm lead (own submissions), governor (anything by default), or Sentinel (automated, on satellite-contradiction evidence). See plans/SUNMINT_MEDIA_INVALIDATION_DESIGN.md.

PARTNER ADD EVENT.description: Onboard a new retail partner to the DAO Partners sheet

PARTNER CHECK-IN EVENT.description: Log periodic check-in with retail partners — stock status, restock needs

PLOT FINANCING EVENT.description: Record a cash ADVANCE from the DAO that finances N trees on a SunMint plot (e.g. a per-plot financing of a farmer's planting). Mints N 'Cacao Tree Planted - Unassigned' pool units on the main ledger and seeds the SunMint Plots 'Contributor Name' registry (col T) with the farmer. Per-plot - a farmer may hold many plots. OPPOSITE DIRECTION to [PAYOUT EVENT]: an advance leaves main BEFORE any sale exists, whereas a payout settles a liability AFTER one. The per-tree INFRASTRUCTURE CHARGE a downstream [TREE PLANTING LINK EVENT] transfers from a managed ledger is a SEPARATE number (Currencies 'Tree Charge', col U) - do not conflate it with this financing amount or with the retail price (Currencies col B). FAIL-CLOSED: if the plot row cannot be positively resolved, book nothing. Handler: process_plot_financing_event_telegram_logs.gs; tracking tab: Plot Financing. Spec: agentic_ai_context/plans/SUNMINT_FARMER_SETTLEMENT_AND_BATCH_LINK_PLAN.md.

PLOT INVALIDATION EVENT.description: Sentinel/governor soft-invalidates a SunMint Plots row (Status -> invalid) so it drops out of the farm dropdown and plots/index.geojson. Never deletes - keeps Plot ID/Plot Name/Notes audit trail, records Invalidated By / Reason / At. Server-side gate: Retractor Email must resolve to a governor or sentinel in dao_members.json (Sophia = sentinel). Use for mangled/duplicate plot rows. Handler: process_plot_invalidation.gs; tracking tab: Plot Invalidation.

PRACTICE EVENT.description: Log a capoeira training session — COPPA-compliant: anonymous keypair, no email required

PRODUCT REGISTRATION EVENT.description: Register a new product SKU in the Agroverse SKUs sheet

PROGRAM REGISTRATION REQUEST.description: Register a new program (lineage program template)

PROPOSAL CREATION.description: Submit a new DAO proposal for community voting

PROPOSAL VOTE.description: Cast a vote on a DAO proposal

QR CODE UPDATE EVENT.description: Update QR code metadata (status, email, manager name). NOTE: the GAS regex expects 'Associated Member' (with 'd') — the DApp UI label 'Associate Member' does NOT match. Always use 'Associated Member' in submissions.

REPACKAGING BATCH EVENT.description: Record repackaging of bulk inventory into smaller units

REPACKAGING SETTLEMENT EVENT.description: Settle a repackaging batch — populate offchain asset location + Currencies metadata after repackaging

RETAIL FIELD REPORT EVENT.description: Log a store visit/update — status changes, remarks, contact info

STORE ADD EVENT.description: Add a new store to the holistic wellness Hit List

TREE GROWTH MONITORING EVENT.description: Farmer-submitted tree growth measurement (photo of calibration card against trunk at breast height + context photo). Client RSA-2048 signed, POSTed to Edgar; GAS mirrors photos to TrueSightDAO/sunmint images/growth/, the GitHub Action runs PM002 analysis and commits analysis.json, and the handler appends the measurement row (Tree Growth Measurements tab), writes per-tree JSON history, and logs to Telegram Chat Logs. Photos + analysis commit URL are carried on the event for VVB audit.

TREE PLANTING EVENT.description: Record a tree planting with photo and location. CONTRACT: send BOTH the canonical Location (e.g. -3.094431, -52.095225; decimal, S/W negative - satisfies Edgar validation) AND Latitude/Longitude decimal fields (the GAS parser fills the SunMint Tree Planting tab lat/lng columns from these lines). Missing Location => validator rejects; missing Latitude/Longitude => parser writes blank lat/lng and the row is auto-INVALID. A Photo URL is REQUIRED: no photo => the planting cannot be verified => reject (do not submit). Species strings are not standardized ('Cacau - Hybrid' pt vs 'Cacao' en) - use the exact string the farm lead specifies. See agentic_ai_context/SUNMINT_TREE_PHOTO_PROCESSING.md section 7.

TREE PLANTING LINK EVENT.description: Governor-only. Links a sold Agroverse QR code (status SOLD) to either a Sunmint tree-planting submission (SunMint Tree Planting, status NEW) or — since PR6 of SUNMINT_FARMER_SETTLEMENT_AND_BATCH_LINK_PLAN.md — a PLOT (SunMint Plots, via `Plot ID`). Flips the QR to ASSIGNED_TO_TREE, copies planting evidence (lat/long/photo for a tree; a representative plot image for a plot), books the ledger fulfillment entry, and notifies the QR owner. Farmer identity for a plot link is resolved server-side from the plot registry, never the payload. Rejected server-side (GAS Governors tab check) if the signer isn't a governor.

TREE PLANTING REJECT EVENT.description: Governor/sentinel-only moderation. Marks a NEW SunMint tree-planting submission INVALID. Shares the TREE PLANTING LINK handler, which parses these same fields on the reject path.

VOTING RIGHTS WITHDRAWAL REQUEST.description: Request to cash out voting rights — signed by contributor, emitted as GitHub JSON for paper trail

VOTING RIGHTS WITHDRAWAL SETTLEMENT EVEN.description: Governor-signed settlement of a voting rights cash-out — deducts TDG from Ledger history, deducts USD from offchain provisions, writes GitHub JSON paper trail

WARMUP SEND EVENT.description: Send a warm-up email draft from Gmail

RESERVATION EVENT.description: Record a cash reservation for a QR-coded item the buyer has paid for but not yet collected (money in, goods held). Books the cash leg only and sets the QR status to RESERVED — no inventory or liability line moves. Spec: agentic_ai_context/RESERVATION_EVENT_SPEC.md.

RESERVATION SETTLEMENT EVENT.description: Settle a reservation — the buyer collects the reserved item. Books the goods legs (inventory −1 off the QR's current holder and +1 Cacao Tree To Be Planted liability), sets the QR status to SOLD, and emails the buyer.

PAYOUT EVENT.description: Record an outbound compensation transfer (e.g. a PIX payout for tree planting). One row per TRANSFER; tree_planting_id is carried as a list because a single transfer may cover N trees. Carries no raw recipient PII (recipient referenced by pk_hash, resolved sink-side against the private payout register). Distinguishes live capture from backfill. FARMER SETTLEMENT: a payout whose `Tree Planting IDs` join a SunMint Tree Planting row is also the farmer-settlement event (agentic_ai_context/plans/SUNMINT_FARMER_SETTLEMENT_AND_BATCH_LINK_PLAN.md §0.10/§0.11) - no separate [FARMER PAYMENT EVENT] tag exists, because a tree-id-bearing payout IS that event. The payout sink (processPayoutEventsFromTelegramChatLogs) books the settlement legs: a COMMITTED tree (its SunMint row already has `Linked QR Code`) books a cross-ledger transfer (-cash on the QR's own ledger, +cash on main, -1 'Cacao Tree - To Be Paid For' on main); an uncommitted tree books -cash / -1 'To Be Paid For' / +1 'Cacao Tree Planted - Unassigned' on main. FAIL-CLOSED: if the SunMint row or the QR's ledger cannot be positively resolved, the sink writes no ledger row and flags the tracking row LEDGER_NOT_BOOKED. Spec: agentic_ai_context/plans/CRF_ANAPU_SUNMINT_COHORT_PROPOSAL.md §12.2/§12.3.

PAYOUT REGISTRATION.description: Declare the PIX payout key a planter wants tree-planting support paid to (CRF Anapu section 11). One row per planting identity (pk_hash); a later registration for the same pk_hash supersedes rather than duplicates. PRIVACY (by LOCATION, section 11.2/11.4): the payload carries the RAW PIX key, written ONLY to the private, governor-only `cfr program` spreadsheet -- never to the publicly-republished Telegram Chat Logs intake -- and the event is excluded from every public JSON cache. Handler: processPayoutRegistrationsFromTelegramChatLogs; private tab: payout registrations. Spec: agentic_ai_context/plans/CRF_ANAPU_SUNMINT_COHORT_PROPOSAL.md section 11.
